title: Balanced Honey Soy Tofu Noodles
subtitle: with Edamame and Sesame Eggs
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles and edamame. Thinly slice the cabbage. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Halve the tofu pieces on an angle. Combine the Chinese barbecue seasoning, sesame oil, 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp honey and 1 tbs water in a bowl.

Cook noodles and edamame: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 5 mins. Add half the edamame, return to the boil and cook for a further 2 mins or until the noodles and edamame are tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Fry eggs: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Crack 2 eggs into the pan and sprinkle the sesame seeds onto the egg whites. Cook for 3-4 mins until just set or cooked to your liking. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry tofu and veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until browned and warmed through. Add the cabbage and garlic and stir-fry for 1 min. Add the noodles and edamame and sauce mixture and stir-fry for a further 1 min or until the cabbage is wilted and the noodles are glossy.
Serve up: Divide the tofu noodle stir-fry among bowls, top with the eggs and enjoy!
Make it yours: Add a kick with a pinch of chilli flakes, or boost the freshness with a scattering of coriander leaves or thinly sliced spring onion, if you have some on hand.
